visual_goal: Show channels calling one set of offer and reservation contracts, whose events feed one metric layer, which feeds experiments and models that loop back to the offer, with journey objectives guarding the offer at peak.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape diagram drawn as a loop. At the far left, a small cluster of generic screens (a laptop, a phone and a plain search box) labeled once 'Channels', with one thick arrow right into a central rounded block labeled 'Offer and reservation', the arrow labeled 'bookings'. From that block one arrow right into a long horizontal pipe labeled 'Event backbone'. From the pipe one arrow right into a gauge dial labeled 'Gauge metrics'. From the gauge two arrows fan out: one up-left into a flask-shaped box labeled 'Experimentation' and one down-left into a kiln-shaped box labeled 'Kiln ML'. One curved arrow from 'Experimentation' back into 'Offer and reservation' labeled 'decisions', and one curved arrow from 'Kiln ML' back into 'Offer and reservation' labeled 'models', closing the loop. Above the offer block, a teal shield labeled 'Journey objectives' with one short arrow pointing down onto the offer block labeled 'guard at peak'.
alt: Channels call one offer and reservation block whose events flow through an event backbone into Gauge metrics, which feed experimentation and the Kiln ML platform; both loop back to the offer, and a journey-objectives shield guards the offer at peak.
